series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a strong downward trend with moderate seasonality. Due to concept drift and unstable model rankings, a weighted combination with dynamic error adaptation is recommended to account for shifting model performance over time.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift present; ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to shifting model performance over time
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.model_landscape.rankings_stable=false (kendall_tau=0.0877) → unstable rankings; inverse-RMSE weights with shrinkage=0.35 (recommended_knobs) provide robustness to rank instability

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → ridge stacking is unstable with concept drift; ADE dynamic error is preferred
